prompt: Continue Phase 6 by adding atomic checkpoint persistence for ADE. Create src/ade/checkpoint_store.py with a CheckpointStore that loads and atomically saves the TaskCheckpoint type introduced in vertical-slice-010. The default path should be .autodev/runtime/checkpoint.json but callers must be able to inject another path for tests. Saving must create parent directories, write deterministic pretty JSON with a trailing newline, fsync before os.replace, and clean up temporary files after failures. Loading must reject missing/non-object/invalid checkpoint payloads clearly. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage for save/load round-trip, parent creation, invalid JSON/object validation, replacement of an existing checkpoint, and cleanup on simulated write failure where practical without third-party dependencies. Export CheckpointStore from ade.__init__. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, scripts, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v before finishing.
title: Add atomic checkpoint persistence
